page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores using Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core ratio. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data.

For network connectivity, the ecs.g5.16xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation model ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent performance for enterprise workloads.

This hardware profile is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, medium-to-large databases, web serving fleets, and application servers that require a balanced distribution of compute and memory resources without specialized GPU acceleration or local high-speed storage.
